verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for an observability platform like SigNoz, so the axis applies. The evidence documents an MCP server, Agent Skills, a coding-assistant plugin, service-account API access and dashboards-as-code, but none of these is an official SigNoz command-line tool. Adjacent programmatic and agent integrations do not count toward a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
